reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering quest items, luck items, lumber, lunarite, magical fishing and food items, and magma resources were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established quest, recipe and glossary names, item effects, pronoun reference, mineral terminology, and register; both found no remaining objective issue.

LobsterBisque_Description.source: This delicate soup is a secret family recipe of Willy's.
LobsterBisque_Description.translation: Această supă fină este preparată după o rețetă secretă din familia lui Willy.

LostAxe_Description.source: Robin's been looking everywhere for it.

LostBook_Description.source: Writings from a wide variety of time periods.

LuckyPurpleShorts_Description.source: Better not inspect these too closely.
LuckyPurpleShorts_Description.translation: Mai bine nu-i cercetezi prea îndeaproape.

LuckyRing_Description.source: The lunar emblem is said to bring good luck to whoever wears it.
LuckyRing_Description.translation: Se spune că emblema lunară îi aduce noroc celui care poartă inelul.

Lumber_Description.source: A versatile resource used for building and fuel.
Lumber_Description.translation: O resursă versatilă, folosită la construcții și drept combustibil.

Lunarite_Description.source: The cratered white orbs form a tight cluster.
Lunarite_Description.translation: Sferele albe, pline de cratere, formează un mănunchi compact.

MagicBait_Description.source: Allows you to catch fish from any season, time, or weather, from whichever type of water you cast into.
MagicBait_Description.translation: Îți permite să prinzi pești din orice anotimp, la orice oră și pe orice vreme, indiferent în ce tip de apă o arunci.

MagicRockCandy_Description.source: A rare and powerful candy infused with the essence of the prismatic shard.
MagicRockCandy_Description.translation: O bomboană rară și puternică, infuzată cu esența Ciobului prismatic.

MagmaCap_Description.source: A very rare mushroom that lives next to pools of lava.
MagmaCap_Description.translation: O ciupercă foarte rară care crește lângă bălți de lavă.

MagmaGeode_Description.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you.

MagmaGeodeStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain magma geodes.
MagmaGeodeStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține geode de magmă.
